_comment: GregTech-style ore veins (docs/design/progression.md 'Ores', ADR 0019). The world is cut into square cells of grid.cell_voxels; each cell holds at most one vein (chance grid.fill), a flat lens size_voxels across and thickness_voxels thick whose centre is jittered but stays inside the cell. The vein type is picked by weight, its centre y uniformly in [y_min, y_max] (voxels, sea level 256). Inside the lens: primary ore in the top third, between in the middle, secondary in the bottom third; any ore voxel becomes the sporadic ore with grid.sporadic_chance; density = share of lens voxels that are ore. pocket_gas / pocket_gas_chance (ADR 0148) = a gas material and the chance a whole ore lump is a sealed pocket of it instead. indicator = surface detail material (loose ore-bearing stones) scattered above the vein within indicators.radius_voxels of its centre while the vein top is at most indicators.max_depth_voxels below the ground; chance per column fades with depth. Materials are GameMaterials names. Regenerate the native header after editing: godot_console.exe --headless --path game --script res://tools/ore_vein_codegen.gd
